title: Successor-dimensional inner product decomposition
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$ and let $F$ be a real-valued family indexed by $F_2^{k+1}$ with values that are functions on $F_2^n$. Its Gowers inner product equals the average over $y\in(F_2^n)^k$ of the product of the two expectations obtained by fixing the last cube coordinate to $0$ and to $1$. Each expectation averages over $x\in F_2^n$ the product of the family values over the remaining $k$ cube coordinates, evaluated at the corresponding points $x+\sum_j s_jy_j$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a real-valued family on the indicated cubes
